title: 28 countries including the US, China and the EU sign the Bletchley Declaration on AI risks at the UK AI Safety Summit
summary: The declaration calls for international cooperation on identifying AI safety risks of shared concern.

title: CNN reports AI-generated explicit images of students at a New Jersey high school, leading to a police report
summary: The images caused distress among students, prompted a school investigation and led to a police report, according to the AI Incident Database summary.

title: xAI unveils Grok, a chatbot with real-time access to posts on X
summary: xAI introduced its first model, Grok, and claims it beats LLaMA 2 and GPT-3.5 on some tests; the claim is xAI's own.

title: Kai-Fu Lee's 01.AI releases open-source Yi-34B, which Hugging Face data show beating Llama 2, Bloomberg reports
summary: 01.AI released Yi-34B, a 34-billion-parameter model in Chinese and English, within eight months of the company's launch.

title: OpenAI introduces GPTs, customised versions of ChatGPT that people can build for specific purposes
summary: OpenAI let individuals create customised versions of ChatGPT, announced on 6 November 2023.

title: Habr, citing WSJ: Nvidia prepares new AI chips for China with reduced performance to meet US export rules
summary: The reported HGX H20, L20 PCIe and L2 PCIe chips keep most of Nvidia's newest AI features, with some computing performance cut to comply with the new US rules.

title: Nvidia announces the H200 AI accelerator, 3DNews reports
summary: Nvidia announced the H200 GPU for AI workloads, an upgrade of the H100 with faster HBM3e memory.

title: NYT reports Argentina's presidential campaigns used AI-generated images and videos, including a deepfake of Javier Milei
summary: The Massa campaign made AI posters and videos and a labelled deepfake of Milei, while Milei shared AI images of Massa that were reportedly viewed over 30 million times.

title: Meta reportedly disbands its Responsible AI division
summary: A timeline of 2023 lists Meta as having disbanded its Responsible AI division in November; the exact day is not given.

title: OpenAI's board removes CEO Sam Altman citing loss of confidence; Mira Murati becomes interim CEO, El País reports
summary: Greg Brockman, removed as board chair, announced his departure the same day.

title: Microsoft says it will hire Sam Altman and OpenAI staff who follow him, 3DNews reports
summary: Microsoft announced it would take on Altman and any OpenAI employees who chose to leave with him.

title: Anthropic releases Claude 2.1 with a 200,000-token context window
summary: Claude 2.1 is a proprietary Anthropic model with a 200,000-token context window.

title: OpenAI announces Sam Altman's return as CEO with a reconstituted board, El Español reports
summary: The company announced Altman's return a few days after its board removed him.

title: Sber presents Kandinsky 3.0, an upgraded text-to-image model, 3DNews reports
summary: Sber presented the third version of its Kandinsky image-generation model during its AI Journey conference week.

title: CNBC: Nvidia reportedly delays its new H20 AI chip for China
summary: Nvidia shares fell after reports that the company delayed the launch of the chip it designed for the Chinese market under US export rules.

title: NYT reports US intelligence officials have concerns about UAE AI firm G42's ties to China
summary: The New York Times reported that US intelligence agencies were concerned about links between G42 and China.

title: Microsoft gets a non-voting observer seat on OpenAI's board, 3DNews reports
summary: After Altman's return the OpenAI board added a Microsoft representative as a non-voting member.

title: Bloomberg: US compels Saudi fund Prosperity7 to exit AI chip startup Rain AI on national-security grounds
summary: Rain AI is a neuromorphic chip startup backed by Sam Altman, according to Bloomberg.
